string.name: desc
string.value: Forms a barrier of ice and lightning. If you get attacked by critical Abnormal Status, the barrier immediately activates and blocks all Abnormal Statuses for a short time. Also increases all elemental and abnormal status resistances permanently.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, upon defending critical Abnormal Status attack, for #time sec, activates a barrier that blocks all Abnormal Status effects and apply #cooltime sec Cooldown.\n[Passive Effect: Increases All Elemental Resistances and Abnormal Status Resistance by #asrR%]
